references.notes: Documents rest-to-smile lip changes in the studied population. Supports treating resting and smiling measurements separately; does not measure Tom Holland or prove his exact movement. Abstract reviewed.

references.title: Young, Hellawell & Hay (1987) · Configurational Information in Face Perception
references.notes: Composite-face recognition experiment: surrounding facial configuration can affect recognition of constituent parts. Context for discussing relationships, not evidence that a particular jaw shape is more attractive.
